newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-CHELSEA LEAD MIDDLESBROUGH 1-0 AT HALFTIME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-CHELSEA LEAD MIDDLESBROUGH 1-0 AT HALFTIME.

text.p: Chelsea led Middlesbrough 1-0 at halftime in the English F.A. Cup final on Saturday thanks to a goal after 43 seconds from Italian Roberto di Matteo.

It was the quickest goal scored in the final since it moved to Wembley in 1923 and was worthy of the occasion, blasted in off the crossbar from 25 metres after the Italian had run from just inside his own half.
Middlesbrough, bidding to become the first team to win the cup in the same season as being relegated, had none of the luck going in the opening 45 minutes.
On the stroke of halftime their Italian midfielder Gianluca Festa had a headed goal disallowed.

They also lost Fabrizio Ravanelli with a recurrence of his hamstring injury and Robbie Mutsoe with a knee injury inside the first 29 minutes. They were replaced by Dane Mikkel Beck and Steve Vickers respectively.

Chelsea dominated for much of the opening period but Middlesbrough began to play their way back in the 15 minutes before the break with Brazilian midfielder Juninho beginning to have some impact after a quiet opening half hour.
